report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 1450ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is application-side, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 1450ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 14ms — 1436ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 14 in last 5 min on products container; Multiple CosmosClient instances: new client created per request instead of singleton. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 14ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 1450ms with 14 Cosmos 429 events, 520 RU/min consumption, host CPU 40%, and SQL latency 55ms. The active toggles (multipleClients) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 1436ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
